patterns.name: log4shell_jndi_lookup
patterns.condition: T1190 with explicit ${jndi:ldap://...}, ${jndi:rmi://...}, or ${jndi:dns://...} in request headers or parameters, or unequivocal Log4Shell exploit description; level >= 10
patterns.evidence: CVE-2021-44228: Log4j JNDI lookup injection can trigger remote code loading from attacker-controlled endpoints.

patterns.name: log4shell_repeated_probe
patterns.condition: T1190 and explicit remote lookup with repeated requests or vulnerability scanning evidence, level >= 10
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: known public-facing application vulnerabilities are targeted with automated probes.

patterns.name: weak_cve_indicator
patterns.condition: T1190-tagged low-confidence CVE/JNDI references without complete remote lookup payload
patterns.evidence: A CVE identifier or JNDI keyword alone is not a confirmed exploitation payload; investigate without blocking.
